devicesMFE.py.summary: DevicesMFE is a comprehensive page object class for HP device management UI automation. It extends HPXFlow and provides extensive verification and action methods for the HP devices micro-frontend. Key patterns include: (1) Verification methods with configurable timeouts and exception handling, (2) Action methods for clicking, scrolling, and window management, (3) Special handling for Windows dummy printers for testing, (4) Retry logic and change checks for reliable element interactions, (5) JavaScript executor usage for hidden elements, (6) Screenshot comparison decorator for visual validation, (7) Environment-specific logic for stage/prod vs regular environments, (8) Popup and dialog handling for feature unavailable and firmware update scenarios, (9) Keyboard shortcuts for page refresh and navigation (CTRL+R, END, PAGE_DOWN), (10) Multiple verification methods for login/logout states. The class supports testing of device cards, printer management, supply levels, profile management, navigation, and various UI components in the HP devices MFE application.
